summary_bullets: Teach the round-mode dirty-tree guard and post-commit residue gate to skip unchanged pre-coder carryover dirt instead of failing legitimate coder commits
Scope primary and follow-up round commits to coder-stage-paths.txt so pre-staged outside-manifest carryover cannot enter the round commit
Add regression coverage for carryover tolerance, staged carryover exclusion, and repurposed fail-closed orchestration
commit_message:
Fix review-and-fix carryover false-positive on dirty-tree guard (#3272)

Align round_tracked_dirty_outside_manifest and post-commit residue checks with the existing pre-coder snapshot exclusion, scope round commits via git-commit.sh --only --pathspec-from-file, and add orchestrator plus extracted-guard regression tests.
